sloka: विकल स कृतो बाणैः खरो रामेण संयुगे ।मत्तो रुधिर गन्धेन तम् एव अभ्यद्रवत् द्रुतम् ॥३-३०-२२॥
transliteration: vikala sa kṛto bāṇaiḥ kharo rāmeṇa saṁyuge ।matto rudhira gandhena tam eva abhyadravat drutam ॥3-30-22॥

translations.english: Completely struck by Rama's arrows, Khara, intoxicated with the smell of blood, ran speedily charging towards Rama.
